sourceFile: 5. BRS-161016(DT) Sunmary Report TEST new JIG improve after repair use new dry machine 2024.04.22_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft cites real rows but misidentifies the changed factor and mixes trial rows, totals, and extracted statistics into unreliable evidence.
issues: Changed factor is nonsensical numeric grouping rather than new/old JIG, dry machine, or dry-method change.
Baseline and test conditions are ambiguous despite old JIG and new JIG evidence rows.
Outcome grouping mixes summary totals, daily trials, duplicate totals, and invalid measurement statistics.
Some computed NG/OK totals appear inconsistent with row table meaning.
Final decision row says new JIG cannot be used but is not integrated into judgement.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the primary comparison be new JIG vs old JIG, new dry machine usability, or dry-method change?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor from title, purpose, content, material labels, and decision rows.
Separate baseline old JIG, new JIG after repair, and dry-method-change contexts if needed.
Use OK, NG S/P separate, NG glue not dry, total NG, and NG rate as yield outcomes only.
Remove synthetic measurement-stat outcomes for temperature and time.
Cite summary decision and representative detail rows for each condition group.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are not sufficient until grouping and outcome interpretation are corrected.
